diagnostics.failure: The first direct API check expected HTTP 403 for a forged Host sent through Node 24 fetch, but received HTTP 200.
diagnostics.cause: A separate local echo confirmed that fetch replaced the custom Host with the actual loopback target, so the request was valid.
diagnostics.resolution: The test now uses node:http to send the actual forged Host. Application behavior did not change.

diagnostics.failure: The first full browser regression left Practice disconnected when opened immediately after a backend restart/reload, before account bootstrap completed.
diagnostics.cause: The opening click checked eligibility before the account response arrived and did not retain an intent to connect after readiness. The added testing catalogue request widened the timing window.
diagnostics.resolution: Practice retains one opening connection intent while bootstrap is busy, consumes it once ready, and cancels it on close, Account opening or sign-out. No automatic battle-command replay was added.
diagnostics.verification: The existing recovery scenario now deliberately holds the real catalogue request, opens Practice before account readiness, releases the request, and requires the same saved revision, HP and weather without a second Connect click.

initialBrowserRun: Both focused browser scenarios passed on their first run; the second was then extended to check direct switching from active shared exploration and is included in the final regression run.
